name: segmentation_benchmark
description:
Public and private set of It's AI segmenation benchmark for ai-detection task. 
In public set you will find:

text - fully ai, partly ai or fully human text (English only)
segmentation_labels - word-level labels (1 for AI, 0 for human)
model_name - which model was used to generate this text or Nan for fully human texts

In private set you will find only text column
reputation: Used in AI-generated-text detection research and by groups working on fine-grained segmentation of machine-generated content; moderately recognized in that niche.
